note: SAC with the active KL update on Walker2d-v5. Each axis selects among beta 50, 55, 60, 65, and 70, using ordinary SAC as the reference; there is no valid inactive KL control. Standard SAC and beta 55--70 have 30 measured policies each. Beta 50 has 29 because seed 23 failed during training; its return curves are conditional on the available checkpoints, with no return imputed for the failed seed.
statistic: Mean of policy-level episode means; bands are ±1 across-policy sample standard deviation, not confidence intervals.
